$comment: Declared versions NOT published from this repository, each with the reason.
State is computed from this repository's git tags. a1 and a2 were published
from dotmac_starter_mt and their tags stay there permanently.
The sole row is the version this tree declares and has not yet published.
The 0.1.0a8 row that sat here between the declaration and the publication was
removed by the RECORDER rather than by a human — the first time that has been
true in this repository. a4's row said never-published and outlived its own
publication by six hours; a7's absence turned protected main red for every open
pull request. Both were the same missing gesture, and verify-release.yml had
already computed everything the record needed before printing ::notice::OWED, a
notice nothing reads.
0.1.0a3 is published and permanently unpinnable; 0.1.0a4 is published,
independently verified, and refused for adoption; 0.1.0a5 is published,
verified on seven properties, and refused for adoption because its declared
dotmac-kernel floor is 21 alphas below the module it imports; 0.1.0a6 is
published, verified, and still pinnable; 0.1.0a7 is published and verified and
carries no approved-plan read API; 0.1.0a8 is published and verified with that
read API; 0.1.0a9 is published, verified, and is the version to pin when a
Foundation descriptor binding and portable authorization are required. All
of them live in
docs/published-versions.json, each superseding disposition APPENDED to its
original record rather than replacing it.
A row here and a row in docs/published-versions.json are never both true
about one version at once, and
test_the_ledger_and_the_published_record_never_claim_the_same_version states
that over the two FILES so it holds even in a tagless checkout.

0.1.0a10.reason: Adds Control-derived version binding to the signed authorization and a purpose-separated, provider-neutral signed target execution observation whose terms are verified against the standing authorization before state changes.
